usage: The word 透明 (tau3 ming4) is an adjective, used to describe something that is clear or see-through.
You can use 透明 to talk about objects like glass, water, or plastic bottles when you want to say you can see through them.
In sentences, 透明 can be placed before a noun to describe its quality, such as 透明膠袋 (transparent plastic bag).
It can also describe abstract things, like 透明流程 (transparent process), meaning clear and open.
When used in negative form, e.g., 唔透明 (not transparent), it means something is not see-through or not clear.
